messages:
liam: CI red on main, seeing intermittent hang in runtime/serve_retry_test. Job: https://ci.redwood.test/teams/infra/builds/4521 :exclamation:
ashok: ugh, which test and where in the logs?
liam: repro is around 115-130s, thread seems to block in Timer::wait_for_next() then retries pile up. snippet:```
[   42.77s] INFO serve_retry_test: starting
[  118.12s] WARN retry_scheduler: pending=4
[  119.99s] DEBUG timer: wait_for_next() slept 10ms then 1s then never returned
```
maria: can you paste the exact bazel command you used? want to try a local run with the same shards.
liam: `bazel test //runtime:serve_retry_test --test_output=errors --runs_per_test=50`
qa-jen: marking as flaky, can we trigger a CI rerun with --runs_per_test=200 to get failure frequency?
dev-bot: @liam requested rerun: `bazel test //runtime:serve_retry_test --runs_per_test=200` queued as build 4522
ci-bot: rerun started (build 4522). Attached logs: https://ci.redwood.test/teams/infra/builds/4522/logs
liam: thanks. If it reproduces, I'll try a bisect with seeds and enable TRACE logging for timers.
ashok: could be clock drift on the container host, we've seen timers misfire when host is overloaded. @sre-katie can you check node metrics for build nodes 3/4/5 around the timestamps?
sre-katie: looking, there's a CPU spike on node-build-4 at 119s in that run. filing an infra watch, will post results in ~15m.
maria: also try setting `TEST_RANDOM_SEED=42` and `--test_arg=--deterministic-timers` if possible to narrow nondet vs infra.
liam: good idea. I'll kick off a debug run with deterministic seed and extra timers: `TEST_RANDOM_SEED=42 bazel test //runtime:serve_retry_test --test_arg=--timer-trace`
qa-jen: if the rerun shows lower frequency, we can add a flaky-test annotation and open a bisect ticket.
liam: build 4522 failed at 120.3s with same hang. I'll start the bisect on main now (quick heads-up).
ashok: thanks — if bisect points to a recent change in the scheduler patch, ping me and I'll review.
liam: pinged when bisect narrows to a commit range. for now I've increased the test timeout as a temporary mitigation: `--test_timeout=300` and added a TODO to follow up.
maria: cheers. jot a short PR description so we don't forget to remove the timeout later.
liam: will do. adding issue #3432 (flaky-serve-timer-drift) and linking logs + bisect steps. :memo:
ci-bot: build 4523 (debug run with seed=42) queued
qa-jen: thanks team, I'll monitor the issue and add it to the flaky-test board.
sre-katie: infra note: investigating noisy host scheduling, will report back with any remediation (cgroups/affinity)
liam: ok locking this thread for async updates — will post bisect result and a minimal repro once available. :lock:
